prompt:
Create a FULL-BODY original Soulmonsters creature for the EXACT head in the attached own reference. This is the chosen face: dark INDIGO wide wedge skull, broad overlapping IVORY forehead and cheek planes, tiny recessed amber eyes, short CORAL muzzle, ivory squared chin, small GOLD knotted root on the near temple. Preserve this face, its angular silhouette, very small eye openings and asymmetrical cheek construction. DO NOT use a long-snouted orange crocodile head, do not uncover large round eyes, do not turn it into a human wearing a helmet. The head is its actual living anatomy.
Build a coherent intermediate-stage bipedal DRAGON OF TENSION around this head, fullbody 3/4 facing right. Strong SHORT neck sinking into sloping shoulders, deep compact wedge-shaped ribcage, flexible narrow waist, heavy hindquarters, two bent digitigrade legs with broad three-toed ivory claw feet. TWO forelimbs with distinct shoulders/elbows/wrists, long enough to hang just below waist; three-digit creature hands clearly visible. The near forearm is thicker with a single curved indigo tension-paper surface integral to its outer side, one narrow ivory leading lip and a gold curved structural edge. Far arm smaller and supple. Neither arm blocks chest or face; pose has a clear negative-space gap beside torso.
The broad angular head is counterbalanced by deep chest and wide grounded leg base, not a skinny human body. A SHORT thick reptile tail grows from pelvis and sweeps backward left, flattens into one indigo stabilizing keel, ending in a continuous gold cord with TWO ivory/indigo chevron tabs. Root and tips visible. One short folded dorsal counterfoil only, rooted directly between shoulder blades, not a pair of large flight wings. Three broad living tension-paper planes organize chest and near shoulder, asymmetrically: one ivory diagonal breast membrane running from rib to opposite flank, coral lower ribs, indigo upper chest/neck. ONE gold knotted flank articulation. No repeated triangular tessellation, crumpled origami skin, accordion arm or piles of decorative armor.
Color hierarchy: INDIGO upper body/forearms/dorsal keel, CORAL shoulders/outer thighs/hips/muzzle, warm IVORY belly/chest fold/leading surfaces and toes, restrained gold spars and knots. Preserve living creature volume and clear reptile joints, with paper membranes as real anatomy. Do not draw human muscular pecs, clothing, mechanical armor, weapons or a helmeted human. The head and torso should share the same few big confident planar transitions, while legs and arms remain continuous rounded volumes.
Stance: poised semi-upright, one hind foot ahead and another braced behind, chest angled slightly forward, one hand half open and other relaxed claw, controlled attentive expression matching reference. Four limbs total, readable roots and all tips within generous margins. Clean authorial 2D manga concept on WHITE, one complete creature only, flat saturated color and one crisp cel shadow, confident dark contour, minimal interior lines. No text, scenery, effects, scales texture, gradients, realistic render, tiny facets or duplicate poses. A balanced living creature/kite structure, distinctive head and coherent body, intermediate rather than final adult knight.
review: Primeiro corpo com a cabeça correta (C/Tirante, identificada pela imagem enviada pelo autor). Autor apontou que a cabeça ficou exagerada; manter como histórico da correção proporcional. Não confundir com B/Espreita, escolhida por interpretação equivocada anterior.

prompt: Edit this OWN original Soulmonsters full-body concept to correct head-to-body proportion ONLY. The whole head is much too large. Reduce the COMPLETE HEAD including ivory forehead planes, indigo cheek crests, coral muzzle, chin and tiny eyes by approximately 30 percent in linear size relative to the unchanged body. Preserve all internal face proportions and the EXACT face design, asymmetrical gold temple knot, expression and small eye slits. Keep the head naturally centered on the neck with a slightly thicker shorter neck transition and adjust connecting contour cleanly. The final silhouette should read as a strong intermediate reptile creature with a smaller head supported by broad shoulders, not a large-headed mascot. Do NOT lengthen head into a snout, change colors, uncover large eyes, remove cheek crests, add helmet, armor or hair. Keep torso, shoulders, arms, hands, legs, feet, dorsal sail, tail, rabiola and pose unchanged in design and scale. Keep same clean 2D manga line and cel colors, white background and full figure with margins. No extra views or text. This is a proportional head reduction, not a new character design.
review: Cabeça reduzida visualmente em relação a v6, preservando crânio índigo/marfim, focinho coral, nó lateral e olhos estreitos. O corpo mantém o desenho de v6 com dois braços, duas pernas, uma vela e duas abas da rabiola. A meta foi redução de cerca de 30%, não medida por landmarks; não afirmar porcentagem exata nem igualdade de pixels. Articulações e dorso exigem vistas antes de rig. Concept em avaliação, sem integração.
